canonicalization.artifact_set_hash: sha256 of UTF-8 lines '<relative-path>\t<sha256>\n' sorted by relative path, excluding manifest.json
canonicalization.json: UTF-8, sorted keys, compact separators, no NaN, one trailing LF
canonicalization.markdown: UTF-8, LF newlines, one trailing LF

mandatory_rerun_events: benchmark implementation or timing boundary changes
retrieval, ranking, filtering, persistence, or deletion behavior changes
comparison system or embedding model version changes
dataset, query population, qrels, workload, compiler, hardware, or OS changes
a licensing or redistribution condition changes

licensing.derived_reporting: allowed only when the report itself is owner-authored and every third-party input is identified with license and provenance
licensing.raw_public_dataset_policy: exclude raw public datasets from the repository publication root; publish hashes, acquisition instructions, provenance, and eligible aggregates
licensing.unlicensed_repository_redistribution: do not grant downstream redistribution rights until the repository owner adds an applicable project license and notices

numerics.phase4_session_aggregation: median of five per-session nearest-rank percentiles
numerics.ratio: comparison nanoseconds divided by VectorKit nanoseconds using decimal arithmetic
numerics.rounding: ROUND_HALF_UP; milliseconds 3 decimals, ratios 2 decimals, percentages 2 decimals
numerics.source_values: integer nanoseconds and full-precision JSON numbers remain machine-readable

publication_exclusions: raw HotpotQA source or transformed corpus payloads
raw physical-device captures and device identifiers
diagnostic, partial, rejected, failed, or disqualified timing evidence
USearch timing comparisons after recall-gate failure
graph performance winner comparisons across non-equivalent hybrid semantics
secrets, absolute local paths, and unpublished binaries

schemas.claim_register: schema_version, artifact_id, report_date, expires_on, counts, claims[]; every claim has the fields enumerated by the Markdown contract
schemas.evidence_index: schema_version, artifact_id, report_date, quality, mac, device; every family contains frozen configuration, recomputed values, and evidence identities
schemas.manifest: schema_version, artifact_id, dates, inventory, files, canonical hash, revisions, input identities, contract, validator
